levels.surface: أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمذاني

notes: «11 - نَصٌّ آخَرُ:» is a label («another text») and is not a link; «رَضِىَ اللهُ عَنْهُ» is a formula

the Imam Musa b. Ja'far is named in Sulayman's own encounter and speaks and acts there («فابتدأني وقال»): a narrated encounter (rule 11), so he is not added; the chain is written to Sulayman, who relates it
